applies_when: User explicitly asks for Corvette construction, Corvette Workshop modules, Corvette part selection, or Corvette-specific in-game use.
A script or study uses ObjectIDs whose library Category is Corvette.
does_not_apply_when: Generating ordinary planetary bases, freighter bases, landmark recreations, skyscrapers, organic scenes, or decorative base builds unless Corvette parts are intentionally selected.
Inferring general architectural rules from Corvette minimum-category requirements or ship-role optimization.

official_mechanics_summary.description: Corvettes are player-built, habitable, multi-passenger starships assembled from Corvette structural modules in the Corvette Workshop. They share object-library and NMS-plugin concerns with base building, but their end goal and validation requirements are ship-specific rather than architectural-base-specific.
official_mechanics_summary.structural_vs_interior: Structural modules are Corvette module objects; interior utility wall modules behave more like fit-out/utility components. Do not collapse these into generic base decoration rules.

boundary_limit_v47.source_status: User-supplied 2026-05-28 community screenshot; official Swarm 6.40 notes reviewed for Corvette-adjacent performance context but exact boundary not confirmed in those notes.
boundary_limit_v47.rule: Functional Corvette builds must fit occupied rotated bounding box within 95m side length around origin; 100m is absolute redline.

lessons_learned_initial.summary: An ObjectID and FBX dimensions prove library identity and placement size, but do not instantiate a real in-game/plugin object by themselves.
lessons_learned_initial.rule: A Corvette generator must call a valid plugin placement path or copy a real plugin-created Corvette template. It must never fall back to cube proxies.

lessons_learned_initial.summary: A proxy preview can hide a failed NMS instantiation path and mislead the user into thinking a build is usable.
lessons_learned_initial.rule: Do not deliver proxy geometry as a Corvette build. If Corvette module instantiation fails, fail cleanly before generating visible placeholders.

lessons_learned_initial.summary: Scanning the scene for templates can accidentally reuse prior generated block proxies.
lessons_learned_initial.rule: Template-copy workflows must only duplicate objects that were directly created by the NMS Builder/plugin and pass runtime custom-property audit.

lessons_learned_initial.summary: Cute object names make debugging and searching hard.
lessons_learned_initial.rule: Generated Blender object names and descriptions for Corvette builds must include ObjectID, NiceName, required category if applicable, and role.

lessons_learned_initial.summary: The full library contains Corvette ObjectIDs, but the current Blender plugin context may not expose Corvette Workshop modules through the same add_part path as normal base parts.
lessons_learned_initial.rule: Run a Corvette-specific add_part probe before assuming a normal base-builder script can instantiate Workshop modules.

recommended_corvette_generation_protocol: Read the universal master docs first.
Read this Corvette repository before selecting or scripting Corvette parts.
Run FULL LIBRARY CHECK and filter Candidate part search terms through Category == Corvette when the prompt is Corvette-specific.
Confirm all seven minimum categories before decorative hull work.
Run a Corvette add_part probe for required ObjectIDs before cleanup or generation.
Use real plugin-created objects only; no proxy fallback.
Run v47 boundary audit; reject/redesign any Corvette layout whose rotated occupied bounds exceed 95m side length on any axis.
Name objects with ObjectID + NiceName + role/category for Blender searchability.
Keep Corvette rules scoped to Corvette projects; do not promote ship-role requirements to ordinary base architecture.
current_known_limitations: No in-game validation screenshots have confirmed the current scripted Corvette result yet.
The user reported they could not find the required Corvette parts in Blender/plugin search.
The plugin instantiation path for Corvette Workshop modules may differ from normal Base Builder placement.
Role/stat optimization is patch-sensitive and should be rechecked against current game state before treating as permanent.

current_known_limitations.description: Swarm-era community warning reports Corvette build boundary around 100m; oversized third-party/Blender ship blueprints may become bugged or cut up.
current_known_limitations.safe_rule: Use 95m occupied rotated bounding-box side length as generator maximum.
current_known_limitations.absolute_rule: Do not target or exceed 100m side length.
current_known_limitations.scope: Corvette-only; do not apply to ordinary bases or architecture.

v44_decorative_use_scope.rule: Corvette ObjectIDs used decoratively outside Corvette builds do not activate Corvette completeness validation.

v48_boundary_clarification.rule: The 95m safe / 100m absolute boundary applies to the entire final Corvette assembly, not only Category == Corvette parts.
include: non-Corvette exterior decorations mounted on the Corvette
non-Corvette interior decorations and furniture placed in the Corvette
lights, signs, decals, pipes, greebles, plants, props, or kitbash elements that remain in the final Corvette export
any helper/scaffold/template object that remains in the final Corvette export
exclude: temporary generation templates not exported as part of the Corvette
external labels/debug grids/reference markers not exported as part of the Corvette
v48_boundary_clarification.scope: Corvette mode only; category-agnostic within Corvette mode.
